# scm_dlp_tenant_config (Resource)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Manages Enterprise DLP tenant-wide configuration including snippet capture, masking level, OCR, and alert exemption periods.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tenant-wide Enterprise DLP settings (singleton). Destroying this resource only
# removes it from state; the tenant keeps its current settings.
#
# Incident notifications and the detection exemption period are managed by
# scm_dlp_alert_settings, and OCR by scm_dlp_ocr_enablement.
resource "scm_dlp_tenant_config" "global" {
  enable_snippets                           = true
  mask_level                                = "PARTIAL_MASK"
  incident_notification_snippets_enablement = true
  enable_structured_data_clustering         = true
  edm_enablement                            = "REQUESTED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `edm_enablement` (String) Exact Data Match (EDM) enablement state. Valid values: REQUESTED, ENABLED, DISABLED.
- `edm_enablement_banner` (Boolean) Whether EDM enablement banner is displayed.
- `enable_snippets` (Boolean) Enable or disable snippet capture during DLP scans.
- `enable_structured_data_clustering` (Boolean) Enable structured data clustering for the tenant.
- `enforce_structured_data_clustering_uniformity` (Boolean) Enforce uniformity on structured data clustering.
- `incident_notification_snippets_enablement` (Boolean) Include snippets in incident notifications.
- `mask_level` (String) Snippet masking level. Valid values are NO_MASK, PARTIAL_MASK, FULL_MASK.
- `ocr_enablement_banner` (Boolean) Whether OCR enablement banner is displayed.
- `structured_data_clustering_minimum_uniformity` (Number) Minimum uniformity score for structured data clustering.

### Read-Only

- `detection_exemption_period_minutes` (Number) Alert detection exemption period in minutes. Read-only here; manage it with `scm_dlp_alert_settings`.
- `id` (String) Tenant identifier.
- `incident_notification_enablement` (Boolean) Whether incident notifications are enabled for the tenant. Read-only here; manage it with `scm_dlp_alert_settings`.
- `ocr_enablement` (String) OCR enablement state for the tenant. Read-only here; manage it per service with `scm_dlp_ocr_enablement`.
- `tfid` (String) Terraform identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: import using the fixed ID "tenant_config".
terraform import scm_dlp_tenant_config.example tenant_config
```
